source.version_difference: CN has 399 logical lines and EN has 400 because EN contains one additional terminal newline. Both contain 106 text-bearing positions (84 named, two multiline, 20 narration) and 293 non-text control-command lines. After normalizing localized speaker labels and text payloads, all 399 non-empty logical lines align; all 293 non-text control commands match exactly. CN remains primary for meaning; EN is used for names and structure cross-check.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 魔王 is the CN title used for the target of the operation.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN renders the target as 'the King'.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Used «Король» in line with EN and project royal terminology; no extra demon-related wording was added.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN supplies the concise title cross-check.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 核心战力 says the core combat strength is not on this ship.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN paraphrases this as the main force not being on the ship.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Rendered as «ключевые боевые силы», retaining the CN emphasis on combat strength.
semantic_differences.resolution: Russian follows the more specific CN wording.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 妄议此事的子裔 refers to descendants who spoke recklessly; 净化 is a euphemism for purging them.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN paraphrases them as heirs making ridiculous comments.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Rendered as descendants who recklessly discussed the matter; the euphemistic verb is retained as «очистил».
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN confirms context.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: The speaker bears the deathly aura of the moment and witnesses a victory grasped from the abyss on behalf of the King.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN has the same image with slightly different English syntax.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Kept both the burden of death and the victory seized from the abyss.
semantic_differences.resolution: No extra agent or event was added.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 嗡 is a humming or resonating sound.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Used «Вж-ж—» to retain the CN hum/resonance.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary for sound symbolism.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: The assassin drew the Steam Knight out under cover of steam and beheaded him publicly.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN says the assassin hid in steam, pulled the knight out, and beheaded him before friend and foe.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Kept the CN action sequence and public nature of the beheading.
semantic_differences.resolution: Russian follows CN; EN confirms context.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 法阵 refers to a magical formation or circle.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN names it an Arts Circle.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Used «магический круг» rather than adding an unsupported technical name.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary for the generic term.

semantic_differences.cn_summary: 弓弩 refers to arrows and crossbows; the text says the character blocked them for Theresis and lost an arm.
semantic_differences.en_summary: EN condenses this to taking an arrow for Theresis.
semantic_differences.ru_summary: Rendered the plural threat as arrows and crossbow bolts, following CN.
semantic_differences.resolution: CN is primary; EN confirms the sacrifice context.
